summary: Updates the scroll-bar thumb position for a UI scroll area. Gets the mutable scroll-value pointer through vtable entry +180, computes the scroll range span from this[62] - this[61], and when the pointer is valid and the span is positive normalizes the current scroll value to a 0..1 progress ratio (reading the value as int or float depending on the byte flag at this+0xF0). The progress is multiplied by the area span (vtable +32 result minus vtable +24 result) and converted by CRTFtol to a thumb pixel position; when it differs from the stored position this[56], the control signals a content change (vtable +44), stores the new position, runs ShortComputation_8970 and refreshes through vtable +176. When the range is empty the thumb is reset to 0.0 via the vtable +56 call and refreshed.

local_names.v2: mutable scroll-value pointer returned by vtable +180
local_names.v7: cached vtable pointer (used for the vtable +56 call)

operations.description: Obtain the mutable scroll-value pointer: call vtable entry at *(this)+180 (field obj+0xB4) and store the result in v2.
Compute the scroll range span v8 = this[62] - this[61] (fields this+0xF8 minus this+0xF4).
Range guard: only proceed when v2 is non-null and v8 > 0.0; otherwise take the zeroed-thumb path.
Read the current scroll value as double: when the byte flag at this+0xF0 is set read *v2 as int, otherwise read *v2 as float; then normalize v9 = (value - this[61]) / v8.
Compute the total area span v10 = (result of vtable +32, field obj+0x20) - (result of vtable +24, field obj+0x18).
Convert progress to a thumb pixel position: v5 = CRTFtol(v10 * v9 + 0.5).

When the computed position differs from the stored thumb position this[56] (field this+0xE0): signal a content change via vtable +44 (field obj+0x2C) with argument 1, store v5 into this[56], run ShortComputation_8970(this), then refresh via vtable +176 (field obj+0xB0).
Zeroed-thumb path: reset this[56] (field this+0xE0) to 0.0 and call vtable entry at *(this)+56 with (this, 1) to propagate the reset.
Refresh the control through vtable +176 (field obj+0xB0) on the fall-through path.

unresolved: The read-only globals flt_59E440 and flt_59E450 are listed as accessed fields but are not directly referenced in the raw source; the existing analysis labels them ZeroThreshold (~0.0f) and DegreesToRadians (DERIVED) and they likely back the 0.0 / 0.5 constants, but that mapping is not evidenced by the packet and is not adopted here.
The vtable call at *(this)+56 (used only in the zeroed-thumb path) has no dedicated field evidence reference; it is described from the raw source only.
The identity of the scroll-area class and of the objects backing vtable entries +24/+32/+44/+56/+176/+180 is not evidenced by the packet.
The legacy ABI name 'Scroll_Progress_Handler' (abi:lead) is consistent with the proposed name.
